name: vfx_telegraph

Key upper-left-front #ffe9d0, rim back-right #9fe8ff, ambient #16233a. Controlled broad brush planes, coloured local-hue dark edges without black outlines. Production single 2D fantasy VFX sprite, render at least1024x1024 (four-times256 export), broad controlled PAINTERLY ENERGY, full effect wholly inside canvas with8%transparent margins. WHITE/neutral greys only no colour. TOP-DOWN perfect CIRCLE etched arcane WARNING RING, thick bright outer rim with notched abstract rune segments, thin inner ring, faint radial hatch fill <=35%alpha. Strongest edge contrast of VFX, centre see-through. Ground decal no perspective/squash, no pedestal. No text/numbers/floor/shadow; truly transparent background, no dark background matte. Ground decals override camera: top-down circular geometry. No character/weapon unless arrow requested.
